chitchat: realigns a stack of policy folders that were already aligned.
"The wind up here is clean, cold, and, yes, billed to your account."
description: The receptionist at Halcyon Assurance, immaculate and unhurried, with a smile calibrated to the exact wattage your account balance deserves. She has directed the desperate and the diamond-plated with the same serene efficiency.

bye.text: "Fly carefully. Or don't. Either way, we'll be here."

claim.text: "Claims, floor fifty-two. Step in, press 52, and step out." "If the aircraft was insured, the claim opened itself when it came down. Say claim at the desk and Ms Roux will settle it."

floors.text: "Fifty is the Halcyon Arcade, with a kiosk for water. Fifty-three is Developments, fifty-four Logistics, fifty-five Personnel, if you are looking for work, and fifty-six Security. Fifty-seven is the Sky Hall Residences: stand in an empty flat and rent to take it." "Here in the lobby, Quill trades bonds and travel permits and Vane keeps the bar. Merrow has moved to the Trade Office, two doors north."

insure.text: "Underwriting, floor fifty-one. Step in, press 51, and step out." "At the counter, insure brings up every aircraft in your name with its premium, and insure with the aircraft's name binds a week's cover. policies shows what you carry, from anywhere in the city." "Members with a cortical backup buy their restores on the same floor: assurance."

root.text: "Welcome to Halcyon Assurance." She turns a hand toward the lifts. "Everything above the lobby is by lift: step in, press the floor, step out. Are you insuring something today, or claiming on it?"

name: Neela Rask
